objective: Separate host and control-engine variance from decode-stage overhead using longer mixed-load windows before selecting another production optimization.
hypothesis: I093's sampled observer is behaviorally bounded but the short mixed window is too variable; longer adjacent windows and explicit control strata can distinguish instrumentation cost from host-state noise.
success_gates: Freeze the same 9B model/tokenizer files, public source records, greedy settings, prompt chunking, output limits, cache state, runtime sources, and metric definitions for both engines.
Reuse I090/I091's locked model, public records, generation settings, source hashes, and B4 cohort definitions without forced logit evaluation.
Require every stage observer to pass a strict <1% decode/tail/resource no-op gate with exact output/finish identity before interpreting its timing.
Measure the common decode-driver boundary with independent fresh processes, balanced AB/BA order, TTFT, decode TPS, end-to-end p95, memory, RSS, and swap.

Admit at most one minimal Aster-owned change only when a stage owns a reproducible >=3% primary gap and all correctness/resource/rollback gates pass; otherwise record attribution and keep defaults unchanged.
next_actions: Run longer adjacent observer-off/on B4 windows with two state orders per engine and retain every raw row.
Require Aster and MLX-LM control order strata within 1% for decode TPS and declared resource ceilings.
Admit no runtime candidate without exact semantics, rollback, and a repeatable >=3% end-to-end gain.

performance_baseline_contract.invalidated_timing_rule: A diagnostic must record null timing deltas, an explicit reason, and a linked valid baseline; it cannot claim a speedup or slowdown.

Prove snapshot, restore, partial rollback, cancellation, finish, and membership-change semantics for KV and recurrent state.
Preserve declared greedy, stochastic sampler, logits-processor, stop, and streaming semantics under target verification.
Clear isolated-process B1/B4/B8 acceptance, TTFT, TPOT, throughput, memory, swap, and mixed-load gates with at least a 3% material effect and no correctness or resource regression.
